name: חֲסַדְיָה
gloss: Yah is faithful in kindness; or the kindness of Yah
summary: A son of Zerubbabel, of David's line, named once in the list of the sons born after the return, beside his brothers Berechiah and Jushab-hesed. The name is חֶסֶד joined to יָה, as in חַסְדֵי יַהְוֶה “the kindnesses of Yahweh” (Lam 3:22): the kindness Yahweh keeps, and which the returned exiles confessed he had extended to them “before the kings of Persia” (Ezr 9:9). Scripture does not explain the name.

evidence.note: Sons of Zerubbabel: “Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, וַחֲסַדְיָה, Jushab-hesed, five.”
“The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah.”
“The חֲסָדִים of Yahweh, that we are not consumed”: the noun with the divine name.
“Our God … has extended חֶסֶד to us before the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving.”

note: TIPNR dates him to the Divided Monarchy in its description; he is a son of Zerubbabel, after the return. The form is the construct-like חֲסַד- with the short divine name; read either as a clause (“Yah is kind”) or as a phrase (“kindness of Yah”); no verse decides.
